ps2.6:3.2: Ayam eva ariyo atthaṅgiko maggo, seyyathīdaṃ -

ps2.6:4.1: Idaṃ kho pana Bhikkhave dukkhaṃ ariyasaccaṃ

ps2.6:4.10: Ayam eva ariyo atthaṅgiko maggo, seyyathīdaṃ --
ps2.6:5.1: Idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan ti me Bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.

ps2.6:55.4: ye tassā gocarā, te tassā ārammaṇā.
ps2.6:56.1: Chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgate iddhipāde paṇṇarasa dhammā, paṇṇarasa atthā, tiṃsa niruttiyo, saṭṭhi ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:57.3: ayaṃ vimaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgato iddhipādo ti pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:57.5: So kho panāyaṃ vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgato iddhipādo bhāvetabbo ti . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:57.6: bhāvito ti pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:57.7: āloko udapādi . . . pe . . . paṭibhānesu ñāṇaṃ paṭibhānapaṭisambhidā.
ps2.6:58.1: Vīmaṃsāsamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgate iddhipāde paṇṇarasa dhammā, paṇṇarasa atthā, tiṃsa niruttiyo, saṭṭhi ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:59.1: Catūsu iddhipādesu saṭṭhi dhammā, saṭṭhi aṭṭhā, vīsasatā niruttiyo, cattārīsañ ca dve ca ñāṇasatāni. Paṭis_II,VI.11:
ps2.6:60.1: Samudayo samudayo ti kho Bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:60.3: Nirodho nirodho ti kho Bhikkhave Vipassissa Bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:60.5: Vipassissa Bodhisattassa veyyākaraṇe dasa dhammā, dasa atthā, vīsati niruttiyo, cattārīsaṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:61.1: Samudayo samudayo ti kho Bhikkhave Sikhissa Bodhisattassa . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:61.5: Kassapassa Bodhisattassa pubbe ananussuttesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:61.7: Nirodho nirodho ti kho Bhikkhave Kassapassa Bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:61.9: Kassapassa Bodhisattassa veyyākaraṇe dasa dhammā, dasa atthā, vīsati niruttiyo, cattārisaṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:62.1: Samudayo samudayo ti kho Bhikkhave Gotamassa Bodhisattassa pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:62.3: Nirodho nirodho ti kho Bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu dhammesu cakkhuṃ udapādi . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:62.5: Gotamassa Bodhisattassa veyyākaraṇe dasa dhammā, dasa atthā, vīsati niruttiyo, cattārisaṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:63.1: Sattannaṃ Bodhisattānaṃ sattasu veyyākaraṇesu sattati dhammā, sattati atthā, cattārīsasatā niruttiyo, asīti ca dve ca ñāṇasatāni. Paṭis_II,VI.12:
ps2.6:64.1: ‘Yāvatā abhiññāya abhiññaṭṭho ñāto diṭṭho vidito sacchikato phassito paññāya,
ps2.6:64.3: cakkhuṃ udapādi ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññā udapādi vijjā udapādi āloko udapādi.
ps2.6:64.4: Abhiññāya abhiññaṭṭhe pañcavīsati dhammā, pañcavīsati atthā, paññāsa niruttiyo, sataṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:65.4: yāvatā sacchikiriyāya sacchikiriyaṭṭho ñāto diṭṭho vidito . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:65.7: Sacchikiriyāya sacchikiriyaṭṭhe pañcavīsati dhammā, pañcavīsati atthā, paññāsa niruttiyo, sataṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:66.1: Abhiññāya abhiññaṭṭhe, pariññāya pariññaṭṭhe,pahānāya pahānaṭṭhe, bhāvanāya bhāvanaṭṭhe, sacchikiriyāya sacchikiriyaṭṭhe pañcavīsasataṃ dhammā, pañcavīsasataṃ atthā, aḍḍhateyyaniruttisatāni, pañca ñāṇasatāni. Paṭis_II,VI.13:
ps2.6:67.1: Yāvatā khandhānaṃ khandhaṭṭho ñāto diṭṭho vidito . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:67.4: Khandhānaṃ khandhaṭṭhe pañcavīsati dhammā . . . pe . . . sataṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:68.4: yāvatā asaṅkhatassa asaṅkhataṭṭho ñāto diṭṭho vidito . . .
ps2.6:68.8: Asaṅkhatassa asaṅkhataṭṭhe pañcavīsati dhammā, pañcavīsati atthā, paññāsa niruttiyo, sataṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:69.1: Khandhānaṃ khandhaṭṭhe, dhātūnaṃ dhātuṭṭhe, āyatanānaṃ āyatanaṭṭhe, saṅkhatānaṃ saṅkhataṭṭhe, asaṅkhatassa asaṅkhataṭṭhe pañcavīsasataṃ dhammā, pañcavīsasataṃ atthā, aḍḍhateyyaniruttisatāni, pañca ñāṇasatāni. Paṭis_II,VI.14:
ps2.6:70.1: Yāvatā dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho ñāto diṭṭho vidito . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:70.4: Dukkhassa dukkhaṭṭho pañcavīsati dhammā . . . pe . . . sataṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:71.3: yāvatā maggassa maggaṭṭho ñāto diṭṭho vidito . . .
ps2.6:71.7: Maggassa maggaṭṭhe pañcavīsati dhammā, pañcavīsati atthā, paññāsa niruttiyo, sataṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:72.1: Catūsu ariyasaccesu sataṃ dhammā, sataṃ atthā,dve niruttisatāni, cattāri ñāṇasatāni. Paṭis_II,VI.15:
ps2.6:73.1: yāvatā atthapaṭisambhidāya atthapaṭisambhidaṭṭho ñāto diṭṭho vidito . . .
ps2.6:73.5: Atthapaṭisambhidāya atthapaṭisambhidaṭṭhe pañcavīsati dhammā . . . pe . . . sataṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:74.3: yāvatā paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāya paṭibhānapaṭisambhidaṭṭho ñāto diṭṭho vidito . . .
ps2.6:74.7: paṭibhānapaṭisambhidaṭṭhe pañcavīsati dhammā . . . pe . . . sataṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:75.1: Catūsu paṭisambhidāsu sataṃ dhammā, sataṃ atthā, dve niruttisatāni, cattāri ñāṇasatāni. Paṭis_II,VI.16:
ps2.6:76.1: Yāvatā indriyaparopariyatte ñāṇaṃ ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ . . .
ps2.6:76.5: Indriyaparopariyatte ñāṇe pañcavīsati dhammā . . . pe . . . sataṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:77.5: anāvaraṇaṃ ñāṇaṃ ñātaṃ diṭṭhaṃ viditaṃ . . . pe . . .
ps2.6:77.8: Anāvaraṇe ñāṇe pañcavīsati dhammā.. pe . . . sataṃ ñāṇāni.
ps2.6:78.1: Chasu Buddhadhammesu diyaḍḍhasataṃ dhammā, diyaḍḍhasataṃ atthā, tīṇi niruttisatāni, cha ñāṇasatāni.
ps2.6:79.1: Paṭisambhidādhikaraṇe aḍḍhanavamāni dhammasatāni, aḍḍhanavamāni atthasatāni, niruttisahassañ ca satta ca niruttisatāni, tīṇi ca ñāṇasahassāni cattāri ca ñāṇasatānīti. Paṭisambhidākathā. Paṭis_II,VII.1: EVAṂ me sutaṃ.
